title: Canned & Frozen Fruits & Vegetables

onscreen_lines.note: Grade A Fancy, solid pack minimum drained weight 96 oz./can. Bright uniform color: white, creamy, or yellowish depending upon variety (not pinkish, gray, or brown). Tender, crisp, crunchy, without mushiness, damaged or broken pieces. Whole or partially whole pieces. No excessive carpel tissue, peel, seeds, or other defects. Defective pieces not to exceed 10% of total number of pieces. Prefer at least 51% of product produced or processed in the USA. Packed: 6/#10.
